subtitle: Kharda, 1795 – The Last Crest of the Maratha Tide

panels.shot: split-panel wide, half showing a Maratha host on dusty Deccan plain, half showing the Nizam’s camp clustered around Kharda fort
panels.action: On the left, Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan sits stern and upright on horseback before a mass of Maratha cavalry; on the right, Nizam Ali Khan stands brooding beside the walls of Kharda, French-drilled lines behind him, storm clouds over the Deccan horizon.

dialogue.text: In 1795, at Kharda, Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan and Nizam Ali Khan fought a war born of arrears and insult—and the Maratha confederacy won its greatest field even as its foundations quietly cracked.

i18n.hi: १७९५ में खरदा पर परशुराम भाऊ पतवर्धन और निज़ाम अली ख़ान भिड़े – बाक़ियों और बेइज़्ज़ती से जन्मा ये संग्राम मराठों की सबसे बड़ी जीत बनी, जबकि अंदर ही अंदर बुनियाद हिल रही थी।

panels.shot: wide establishing shot of the Deccan plateau at dusk
panels.action: The rocky Deccan plateau stretches under a fading sky; small forts crown low hills, distant campfires flicker, and a thin line of dust marks a marching army on the horizon.

dialogue.text: By the late eighteenth century, the Mughal centre had faded, and the Deccan was ruled by powers that once served it—Marathas in Poona, the Nizam in Hyderabad, each measuring rank and tribute more sharply than ever.

i18n.hi: अठारहवीं सदी के अंत तक मुग़ल केंद्र ढह चुका था; दक्खन पर अब उसके पूर्व ख़िदमतगार हावी थे – पूना के मराठा, हैदराबाद का निज़ाम, दर्जा और नज़राने पर पहले से ज़्यादा नापतौल।

panels.shot: intercut medium close-ups, left Parshuram Bhau in Poona durbar, right Nizam Ali Khan in Hyderabad court
panels.action: On one side, Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan stands in a crowded Poona hall, scroll in hand before an ornate Peshwa throne; on the other, Nizam Ali Khan sits on a cushioned seat in a high-pillared Hyderabad darbar, brows knit as a vakil reads out a Maratha demand.

dialogue.text: Maratha papers speak of arrears due from Hyderabad and of a minister’s slight to the Peshwa; in Hyderabad, Nizam Ali Khan chafed at Maratha suzerainty and the tone of their envoys.

i18n.hi: मराठा काग़ज़ों में हैदराबाद के बकाये और पेशवा की तौहीन का ज़िक्र है; उधर हैदराबाद में निज़ाम अली ख़ान मराठा बादशाहत और उनके वक़ीलों के लहजे से खौल रहा था।

panels.shot: over-the-shoulder close-up from behind Parshuram Bhau, looking at a crumpled letter from Hyderabad
panels.action: Parshuram Bhau stands by a balcony in Poona, crumpling a Persian-lettered farman while the city roofs spread below; his jaw is set, and a Maratha officer waits tensely behind him.

dialogue.text: The Peshwa’s correspondence, preserved in the Daftar, shows tempers rising note by note—claims of unpaid sums, disputes over territory, and the demand that the Nizam dismiss the minister blamed for insult.

i18n.hi: दफ़्तर में रखे पेशवे के खतों में हर चिट्ठी के साथ मिज़ाज चढ़ता दिखता है – बाक़ी रक़म, सरहद के झगड़े, और वो मांग कि तौहीन का ज़िम्मेदार वज़ीर हटाया जाए।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nizam Ali Khan in council with British and French officers
panels.action: Inside the Hyderabad court, Nizam Ali Khan confers with a red-coated British officer and a French officer in European dress, maps of the Deccan spread before them, while courtiers look on uneasily.

dialogue.text: To strengthen his hand, the Nizam turned to European expertise—Frenchmen like Michel Raymond drilled his infantry, while British residents weighed promises and policy from Calcutta.

i18n.hi: हाथ मजबूत करने को निज़ाम ने यूरोपीय हुनर पकड़ा – मिखेल रेमों जैसे फ़रांसिसी उसकी पैदल फौज भिड़ा रहे थे, और अंग्रेज़ रेज़िडेंट कलकत्ता से वादे और सियासत तौल रहे थे।

panels.shot: wide battlefield council shot under a tent in the Maratha camp
panels.action: In a large campaign tent lined with spears and shields, Parshuram Bhau Patwardhan stands over a rough map of the Deccan, around him representatives of Scindia, Holkar, Bhonsle and Gaekwad, each in distinct attire, listen with varied expressions—some eager, some wary.

dialogue.text: For this quarrel, the Maratha houses gathered: troops from the Peshwa, Scindia, Holkar, Bhonsle, Gaekwad—each with its own pride and grievances—but for once riding under a common cause.

i18n.hi: इस झगड़े पर मराठा घराने जुटे – पेशवा, शिंदे, होलकर, भोंसले, गायकवाड़ की फ़ौजें; सबका अपना गुरूर, अपनी शिकायतें – पर इस बार एक साथ कूच पर।

panels.shot: low-angle wide shot of the Maratha army on the march
panels.action: Columns of Maratha cavalry and infantry move across a dusty plain, banners fluttering; at the head, Parshuram Bhau rides in armour and turban, his hand raised as scouts fan out ahead.

dialogue.text: The Daftar names Parshuram Bhau as commander in the field; under his eye, the confederacy moved toward the Nizam’s forces near the small fort of Kharda, each ally counting both honour and share.

i18n.hi: दफ़्तर परशुराम भाऊ को मैदान का सरदार बताता है; उनके इशारे पर महासंघ खरदा के छोटे क़िले के पास जुटे निज़ामी फ़ौज की ओर बढ़ा, हर साथी इज़्ज़त और हिस्सा दोनों गिनता हुआ।

panels.shot: wide shot of opposing camps with Kharda fort between
panels.action: Across a gently undulating plain, two armies face each other at a distance; the Nizam’s tents and Raymond’s disciplined lines stand nearer to a stone fort on a low hill, while the Maratha encampment sprawls opposite, smoke rising from countless fires.

dialogue.text: On 11 March 1795, near Kharda, the two hosts at last faced each other—Maratha cavalry massed in loose depth, and the Nizam’s mixed army, including Raymond’s French-drilled battalions, drawn up nearer the fort.

i18n.hi: ११ मार्च १७९५ को, खरदा के पास दोनों लश्कर आमने-सामने आ खड़े हुए – मराठा सवार ढीली गहराई में, और निज़ाम की मिली-जुली फ़ौज, जिसमें रेमों की फ़रांसीसी सिखलाई पलटनें भी क़िले के क़रीब कसी हुईं।

panels.shot: dynamic mid-wide of the battle’s opening movements
panels.action: A tense battlefield scene shows Raymond’s straight lines of infantry advancing with bayonets fixed and cannon wheeled up, while swarms of Maratha horsemen wheel on the flanks, dust clouds curling under their hooves.

dialogue.text: Contemporary accounts differ on numbers and on which contingent struck hardest, but they agree: Raymond’s corps pressed forward in European order, while Maratha horse and guns hunted for the open edges.

i18n.hi: हमज़मानी बयान गिनती और किसने ज़्यादा चोट की इस पर अलग हैं, पर एक पर सहमत हैं – रेमों की टुकड़ी यूरोपी अंदाज़ में बढ़ी, और मराठा घोड़े-तोप खुले किनारों की शिकार पर।

panels.shot: close, slightly low-angle shot on Parshuram Bhau amid battle
panels.action: Amid swirling riders and smoke, Parshuram Bhau sits firmly in the saddle, arm outstretched, signalling a wing to swing around; his face is calm but intent, as cannon smoke drifts past.

dialogue.text: Bakhar tradition glorifies sudden charges and single heroes; modern historians, comparing papers and letters, emphasise instead the steady pressure of Maratha manoeuvre and the commanders’ use of the terrain.

i18n.hi: बख़रें अचानक धावे और अकेले सूरमाओं को आसमान पर चढ़ाती हैं; नए इतिहासकार काग़ज़ और खत मिलाकर बताते हैं कि असली काम मराठा चालों की लगातार पकड़ और ज़मीन के चतुर इस्तेमाल ने किया।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nizam Ali Khan watching his lines bend back toward Kharda
panels.action: From a slight rise, Nizam Ali Khan, in rich robes but wearing light armour, watches his lines contract toward Kharda; courtiers cluster near him, and a standard-bearer hesitates as cannon smoke thickens.

dialogue.text: The Nizam’s army did not break at once; it fell back toward Kharda. But as it withdrew into the fort’s shadow, the Marathas moved quickly to cut the roads and water, turning field battle into siege.

i18n.hi: निज़ाम की फ़ौज तुरंत नहीं टूटी; वो खरदा की ओर सिमटती गई। पर जैसे ही वो क़िले की छाया में घुसी, मराठों ने फटाफट राहें और पानी काटे, मैदान को घेराबंदी में बदल दिया।

panels.shot: wide shot of Kharda fort ringed by Maratha positions
panels.action: Kharda fort stands on its rocky mound, bastions stark against the sky; all around, Maratha trenches, gun positions and camps ring it in a tightening circle, ladders and gabions stacked in readiness.

dialogue.text: Kharda was no great metropolis, but its walls now held the Nizam’s main force. The Marathas settled in, their siege lines drawing a hard ring around allies and adversaries alike inside.

i18n.hi: खरदा कोई बड़ा शहर नहीं था, पर अब उसकी दीवारों में निज़ाम की जान से प्यारी फ़ौज फँसी थी। मराठों ने डेरे डाल दिए, उनकी घेराबंदी की लकीरें अंदर बैठे यार-दुश्मन सबको एक सख़्त घेरा में बांधती गईं।

panels.shot: closer shot of Maratha siege camp life at night
panels.action: By night, the Maratha camp stretches under stars; soldiers cook, mend gear, and doze by fires, while in the foreground Parshuram Bhau confers quietly with a Gaekwad officer over a map lit by a single lamp.

dialogue.text: The siege tightened day by day. Letters from the camp track disputes over shares of plunder and command, yet also show the houses holding together long enough to keep the Nizam’s army penned.

i18n.hi: दिन-ब-दिन घेरा कसता गया। कैंप की चिट्ठियों में माल-ए-ग़नीमत और सरदारी की खींचतान भी दिखती है, पर ये भी कि घराने इतना साथ टिके रहे कि निज़ाम की फ़ौज क़ैद से बाहर न निकले।

panels.shot: interior shot inside Kharda fort, dim and tense
panels.action: Within a shadowed room of Kharda, Nizam Ali Khan sits at a low table strewn with reports; beside him, a gaunt officer gestures anxiously, while through a small window the crowded inner courtyard reveals soldiers and camp women drawing from a nearly dry well.

dialogue.text: Inside Kharda, supplies ran low. Later historians, using both Maratha and Hyderabad sources, describe mounting shortages and pressure, the Nizam’s commanders urging either a desperate breakout or terms.

i18n.hi: किले के अंदर रसद घटती गई। बाद के इतिहासकार, मराठा और हैदराबाद दोनों स्रोत मिलाकर लिखते हैं कि कमी बढ़ती गई, दबाव चढ़ता गया, और निज़ाम के सरदार या तो जान तोड़ कर निकलने या सुलह पर ज़ोर डालते रहे।

panels.shot: medium shot of a British envoy in Hyderabad receiving news
panels.action: In a Hyderabad residency office, a British official in East India Company dress reads a dispatch with a frown; behind him, a map of India shows British districts in one colour and Maratha lands in another.

dialogue.text: The Nizam had hoped for British arms against the Marathas, but Governor-General John Shore’s letters from Calcutta tell another story: the Company would not yet fight the confederacy on Hyderabad’s behalf.

i18n.hi: निज़ाम मराठों के ख़िलाफ़ अंग्रेज़ी मदद चाहता था, पर कलकत्ता से गवर्नर-जनरल जॉन शोर के खत कुछ और कहते हैं – कंपनी अभी हैदराबाद के लिए मराठा महासंघ से भिड़ने को तैयार नहीं थी।

panels.shot: medium shot of Nizam Ali Khan receiving envoys from the Maratha camp
panels.action: In a hall within Kharda, Nizam Ali Khan sits upright yet weary as Maratha envoys stand before him, scroll in hand; their faces are firm, his expression a mix of calculation and reluctance.

dialogue.text: Cut off and without British support, the Nizam opened serious negotiations. The settlement that followed, recorded in Maratha and British sources, demanded money, land, and the surrender of the minister blamed for insult.

i18n.hi: कटे हुए और अंग्रेज़ सहारे से महरूम निज़ाम ने असली बातचीत खोली। जो समझौता हुआ, जिसे मराठा और अंग्रेज़ दोनों ने दर्ज किया, उसमें नक़द, ज़मीन और तौहीन के मुज़रिम वज़ीर की सुपुर्दगी मांगी गई।

panels.shot: close shot of a treaty document being sealed
panels.action: A close view of hands: a Maratha scribe’s hand guiding a quill across a treaty sheet, the Nizam’s signet ring pressing a seal into wax, while another hand, in courtly Hyderabad style, rests on the table’s edge.

dialogue.text: The terms forced territorial concessions and indemnity. The minister whose words had sparked outrage was given up. For the Maratha houses, this was vindication; for the Nizam, it was a chastening loss.

i18n.hi: शर्तों ने इलाक़ा भी छीना और भारी जुर्माना भी; जिस वज़ीर की ज़बान से आग लगी थी उसे सौंपना पड़ा। मराठा घरानों के लिए ये जीत का सबूत थी; निज़ाम के लिए कड़वी शिकस्त।

panels.shot: wide shot of Maratha leaders in camp after the victory, dawn light
panels.action: At dawn, before the sprawling camp, Parshuram Bhau stands with representatives of Scindia, Holkar, Bhonsle and Gaekwad; some clasp hands, others stand slightly apart, each surrounded by their retainers, while Kharda’s silhouette lies behind them.

dialogue.text: Kharda was the last great unified victory of the Maratha confederacy over another major Indian power. Yet even in the afterglow, papers record quarrels over credit, reward and future policy.

i18n.hi: खरदा मराठा महासंघ की किसी बड़े हिंदुस्तानी ताक़त पर आखिरी बड़ी साझा फ़तह रही। पर इसी रोशन जीत के बाद भी काग़ज़ों में श्रेय, इनाम और आगे की सियासत पर झगड़े दर्ज हैं।

panels.shot: time-lapse style composite: Kharda battlefield fading into later scenes of British troops in the Deccan
panels.action: The foreground shows the empty Kharda field, trampled but quiet; in a ghostly overlay, British-led sepoy ranks march in European drill across another Deccan plain, while distant forts bear Maratha flags lowered beside the Union Jack.

dialogue.text: Within a decade, Assaye and the Second Anglo-Maratha War would show a different tide—Kharda stands not as a rescue of empire, but as its high-water mark, a reminder of how unity can peak even as decline begins.

i18n.hi: एक दशक के अंदर असये और दूसरा अंग्रेज़–मराठा युद्ध नई लहर दिखाएंगे – खरदा किसी मुग़ल जैसी सल्तनत की वापसी नहीं, बल्कि चरम किनारा था, ये याद दिलाते हुए कि ज़ुल्फ़-ए-इत्तिहाद शिखर पर हो सकती है, जब ढलान शुरू हो चुका हो।
